title: Binance Adds AGLD, AUDIO, BICO, GTC, JASMY, LPT, QUICK, RNDR on Cross Margin and HIGH, MC, OOKI, SPELL on Isolated Margin
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has added  AGLD,  AUDIO,  BICO, GTC, JASMY, LPT, QUICK and RNDR  as new borrowable assets on  Cross Margin , and  HIGH, MC, OOKI and SPELL  as new borrowable assets on  Isolated Margin . New Cross Margin Pairs:  AGLD/USDT, AGLD/BUSD, AGLD/BTC, AUDIO/USDT, AUDIO/BUSD, AUDIO/BTC, BICO/USDT, BICO/BUSD, BICO/BTC, GTC/USDT, GTC/BUSD, GTC/BTC, JASMY/USDT, JASMY/BUSD, JASMY/BTC, LPT/USDT, LPT/BUSD, LPT/BTC, QUICK/USDT, QUICK/BUSD, QUICK/BTC, RNDR/USDT, RNDR/BUSD, RNDR/BTC New Isolated Margin Pairs:   HIGH/USDT, HIGH/BUSD, HIGH/BTC, MC/USDT, MC/BUSD, MC/BTC, OOKI/USDT, OOKI/BUSD, SPELL/USDT, SPELL/BUSD, SPELL/BTC. Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits and rates.
